title: Théorie des cycles algébriques : conjectures de Hodge, Tate, Lefschetz, Weil : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

deep.reconstruction: This page has no mathematical content of its own. It is a blank sheet, numbered '42' in pencil at the lower left (archive foliation). The very faint typewritten text visible on it is show-through or offset from the adjacent typed letter to Serre, dated 27.8.65, transcribed as the next page. The faint layout matches that letter closely: a date at the upper right, the salutation 'Mon Cher Serre,', a first paragraph ('Je continue à retourner dans tous les sens les questions de cycles algébriques ... C^i(X) ... ξ ∈ C^1(X) la classe de Y'), and a second paragraph opening with the underlined 'Conjecture A' (Lefschetz-type isomorphism C^i(X) → C^{n-i}(X) given by multiplication by ξ^{n-2i} on cycles modulo algebraic equivalence). That letter is published in the Grothendieck–Serre Correspondence. It states the 'standard conjecture' of Lefschetz type in purely geometric form, which Grothendieck later published as 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (Bombay 1968/69). Nothing on this sheet adds to it. The sheet sits between the handwritten notes on the previous page (Tate conjecture for products of elliptic curves / abelian varieties, algebraic classes = Galois invariants) and the typed letter.
deep.surprise_reason: The page is blank apart from bleed-through of the 27 August 1965 letter to Serre on the next sheet. That letter is already published in the Grothendieck–Serre correspondence, and its content (standard conjecture A of Lefschetz type) is well known.
transcription_corrections: The faint text is identifiable as show-through of the next page's typed letter (date '27.8.65' at upper right, 'Mon Cher Serre,', the paragraph on C^i(X), and an underlined 'Conjecture A' heading). It is not independent text on this sheet.
The '42' at the lower left is a handwritten archival page number.
